tools.name: find_similar_tracks
tools.description: Find songs or tracks that sound similar to, resemble, or are sonically related to a specific released recording. tools.name: render_track_results
tools.description: Display previously retrieved MusicAtlas similar-track results in an interactive audio player. Accepts the source track, matching tracks, and optional hashtags. Does not perform a new search. Intended for clients that use a separate rendering step; find_similar_tracks also supports direct rendering.

tools.name: find_similar_artists
tools.description: Find artists that are similar, sonically related, or musically adjacent to a specific artist. Use when a user asks for artists like or similar to a named artist. Results include ranked artist matches, MusicAtlas artist URLs, and supporting track examples.

tools.name: find_playlists
